assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the intermittent arrhythmia that may be causing the patient's syncope and near-syncope episodes
